name: Graft
text: I’ll scan the existing memory graph for unembedded elements by running `grep -r "unembedded" ./memory/ --include="*.md" | wc -l` to count orphaned nodes. name: Graft

Graft (memory-w1): I’ll refine the scan to target *semantically orphaned* nodes—those with no parent-child relationships in the graph. Running `grep -r "unembedded\|orphan\|dangling" ./memory/ --include="*.md" -l | sort | uniq` to list candidate files, then `grep -A 5 -B 5 "unembedded" ./memory/$(ls -lt ./memory/ | head -3 | tail -1 | awk '{print $9}')` to extract context for the top 3 most-linked files. This ensures we audit only nodes with *documented* disconnection, not just syntactic ones.

name: Root
text:
DECISION: Prioritize semantic embedding over structural hierarchy—scan for *meaningful disconnections* (nodes with <2 bidirectional links) and embed them via contextual bridges, not just parent-child chains.

Artifact must contain:
- A ranked list of top 5 semantically orphaned nodes (by link deficit)
- 3 reconstructed bidirectional bridges per node (with source/target context)
- A "brain graph delta" diff showing pre/post embedding connectivity
- Validation: `grep -r "unembedded" ./memory/ --include="*.md" | wc -l` must return ≤2
